Nathan Labenz and Prakash Narayanan examine mounting evidence of rapid AI acceleration alongside guests Brian Zhou of Thoughtful, Mike San Miguel of Luxor Technology, and Bryan Bischof of Theory Ventures. The discussions unpack how frontier agents fared when trading real money on midterm election forecasts, the intense physical constraints and compliance rules shaping secondary GPU transactions, and how venture firms use thousands of agent runs to identify alpha. Anchored by METR's assessment and Anthropic's amended regulatory filings, the hosts explore whether frontier labs are on the brink of dramatic, AI-driven progress that could outpace human oversight. Together, they confront the stakes of an imminent takeoff into an agentic economy and debate how rapidly advancing autonomous systems must be governed.

For full show notes, links, and references, read the episode page:https://www.cognitiverevolution.ai/ai-am-is-this-the-ai-we-want-alarming-acceleration-ai-election-bets-gpu-trading-ai-native-vc/
